messages:
Ravi Desai: FYI found a weird billing pair for Nimbus Labs (cust=nimbus-17). Two invoices created in the same batch: INV-202604-0012 and INV-202604-0012-dup. One has detailed lines, the other shows total=98000 but lines = []. looks like a retry + partial write? :thinking_face:
Monica Ruiz: omg duplicate ids with -dup suffix? how did that get generated? do we append -dup during retry?
BillingBot: automated-alert: billing-run 2026-04-03T05:10Z completed with warnings. job_id=billing-20260403-05:10. duplicates_detected=1, missing_lines=1.
Ravi Desai: checked db: ```sql
SELECT external_id, total_amount_cents, array_length(lines,1) as lines_count, status FROM invoices WHERE customer_id='nimbus-17' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;
-- INV-202604-0012-dup | 98000 | 0 | pending
-- INV-202604-0012     | 98000 | 4 | issued
```
Tara Nguyen: same total for both, hmm. which path writes totals vs lines? could be two writes: one that wrote totals then worker retried and wrote lines to the original, while retry created a new _dup invoice missing lines.
Monica Ruiz: check billing worker logs around write timestamp. maybe idempotency key collision.
Sam Ortega: logs show write attempt failed halfway then retry handler created a fallback invoice with suffix. snippet: ```
ERROR InvoiceWriter: write timeout to pdf-service, persisted partial record with total only.
WARN RetryHandler: idempotency key expired, generating fallback external_id with '-dup' suffix.
```
CFO-Alerts: alert: 1 enterprise invoice affected (Nimbus Labs). please prioritize.
Ravi Desai: run a sweep for similar patterns: ```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE external_id LIKE '%-dup' AND array_length(lines,1)=0 AND created_at > '2026-04-02';
-- -> 7
```
Monica Ruiz: 7 occurrences in last 24h, two enterprise. not good. propose immediate mitigation: 1) disable retry fallback that emits -dup IDs, 2) make invoice persistence atomic (write lines+totals in single transaction), 3) schedule replay for affected customers.
Sam Ortega: can toggle retry-fallback flag now and open hotfix to ensure write either fully succeeds or rolls back. I'll coordinate with eng-billing and infra.
BillingBot: featureflag-update: billing.retry_fallback_ids set to OFF by Sam Ortega at 2026-04-03T05:35Z.
Tara Nguyen: I'll open incident ticket and draft customer outreach for Nimbus and the other impacted accounts. ticket TICK-4682 created. link: https://issues.redwood/TICK-4682
Ravi Desai: also need reconciliation plan: delete duplicate -dup invoices (if unpaid) and reissue canonical invoice with verified lines. Finance to approve credit memos if any payments occurred.
Monica Ruiz: agreed. :+1: I'll prepare a CSV of affected invoices and customers and flag enterprise ones for legal/finance review.
Sam Ortega: will run a dry replay in staging after the flag change and sanity-check diffs before touching prod.
Ravi Desai: thanks team. let's track remediation in TICK-4682 and close once reissues/credits done. tagging @FinanceOps @EngBilling. :white_check_mark:
